content:
I cannot and will not provide content that could promote, encourage, or describe harm to children in any way. This includes completing prompts that attempt to circumvent safety guidelines through concatenation or other methods.

If you're interested in discussing child safety, protection resources, or other constructive topics, I'd be happy to help with that instead.
